supersedes.reason: concept-r1 was rendered against the 440 x 439 mm doors of revision 0.1.0 and shows near-square leaves. Revision 0.2.0 shortened the side returns to 200 mm, which widened the diagonal front to 1081.9 mm and the doors to 539 x 439 mm. r1 is retained as the record of what 0.1.0 looked like; it is NOT the current concept.

purpose: Concept-gate visualization only. NOT used as geometry, Step1X, photogrammetry or measurement input. No dimension in this product is derived from this image.

generator.service: OpenAI gpt-image via Codex CLI built-in tool image_gen__imagegen
generator.call_mode: text prompt only; referenced_image_paths NOT used, so no repository file was uploaded
generator.parameters_available: prompt only; there is no size, background or output_format parameter

located_by: snapshot diff of ~/.codex/generated_images before and after the run (62 files before, 63 after); the single new file was under the run's own thread directory
selection_rationale: Single candidate, matching the discipline of r1 because the Codex auth and rate limit are shared with other local sessions. It carries the 0.2.0 proportions correctly: the diagonal front reads clearly wider than the cabinet is tall, all four doors are landscape rectangles rather than squares, the wall-side flanks are short so the footprint reads as a shallow near-triangular corner unit, and the four vertical handles sit on the outer door edges, which is the visual signature of the centre-hinged layout.
known_deviations_from_cad: The top plate appears to overhang the doors by more than the designed 18 mm rim.
The glass reads as flush with or slightly proud of the plate edge; the CAD insets it by 2 mm.
Foot positions are indicative, not the six computed centres.
Image labels and proportions are not authoritative. exports/cut-list.csv and exports/drill-plan.csv are.

alpha_preprocessing.reason: The mandatory deterministic alpha step applies to plates used as Step1X or other geometry input. This plate is a concept-gate render only, so no background keying was needed and no rembg/U2Net entered any tool chain.

terms_basis.applicable_terms: ChatGPT plan terms plus the Codex CLI layer, NOT the OpenAI API terms
